name: Dark Days of the Dead
description:
Turns the game into a classic Romero zombie game.  You must destroy the brain.  Getting bitten is fatal.  However, zombies don't evolve, and when they're down, they're down.  Removes the sci-fi and interdimensional aspects of CDDA.

Dark Days of the Dead is set in Alberta, Canada, sometime during the late 20th century.  Prepare for less advanced technology, rolling plains, and rainier weather.
